description: The whole measurement history of a city from the Atmy Data Hub: PM2.5 per month with the month's weather from 2026-01, yearly means (complete years marked), the dirtiest and cleanest months and days. For questions like "how has the air changed" or "the most polluted month on record".

city.description: City name in any of the site languages, a slug like "russia/krasnoyarsk", or the Atmy city id.

country.description: Country name, to tell apart cities with the same name.

lang.description: Language of city and country names and of the page link; default en.

lat.description: Latitude; with lon, the nearest city with an Atmy summary within 50 km.

name: get_air_quality_monthly
title: Monthly air quality history
